university_info.name: Zambia Catholic University
university_info.vision: To be a leading Catholic university in Africa promoting integral human development.
university_info.mission: To provide quality education rooted in Catholic values, critical thinking, and service to humanity.
university_info.description: Zambia Catholic University ZCU is a private Catholic institution of higher learning in Zambia offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs across multiple faculties.

faqs.question: How do I apply to ZCU?
faqs.answer: Apply online at www.zcu.ac.zm/admissions. You need a Grade 12 certificate with at least 5 credits including English.

faqs.question: What are the tuition fees?
faqs.answer: Undergraduate programs cost K18,500 per semester. Postgraduate programs cost K22,000 per semester. Fees are reviewed annually.

faqs.question: Where is ZCU located?
faqs.answer: ZCU is located on Mpanshya Road, Lusaka, Zambia.

faqs.question: What programs does ZCU offer?
faqs.answer: ZCU offers programs in Business Administration, Information Technology, Education, Nursing, Law, and Theology.

faqs.question: What is the ZCU motto?
faqs.answer: The motto of Zambia Catholic University is Veritas et Lux meaning Truth and Light.

faqs.question: When does the semester start?
faqs.answer: Semester 1 starts in February and Semester 2 starts in August each year.

faqs.question: Does ZCU have a library?
faqs.answer: Yes ZCU has a fully equipped library open Monday to Friday 8am to 8pm and Saturday 9am to 5pm.

faqs.question: How do I contact ZCU?
faqs.answer: Call +260 211 123456 or email info@zcu.ac.zm. Visit us at Mpanshya Road Lusaka.

faqs.question: Is there student accommodation?
faqs.answer: ZCU provides limited on-campus accommodation. Students are advised to apply early as spaces are limited.

faqs.question: What scholarships are available?
faqs.answer: ZCU offers merit-based scholarships and bursaries. Contact the admissions office for current opportunities.
